verdict.rationale: Sprinto's GraphQL Developer API supports introspection, so a client can retrieve a machine-readable schema of its queries, mutations and response types. That is an equivalent of an OpenAPI spec, but only behind an admin-level API key against a live tenant. No static downloadable spec exists: the docs corpus has no OpenAPI or Postman download, OpenAPI fragments appear only inline for the custom-integration sync API, and probes of standard openapi.json/swagger.json paths all return 404. missing for 10: a publicly downloadable spec file (OpenAPI, Postman, or a published GraphQL SDL), access to the schema without credentials, and independent or hands-on confirmation that introspection works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Introspection allows the API to describe its schema, including available queries, mutations, and response types.
You can use the playground to explore the API schema, test queries and mutations, and validate responses in real time.
